notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}.
Shipwreck Dowser's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Shipwreck Dowser's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Shipwreck Dowser's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
